content:
sam: just merged PR #8423 (small batching change) and main turned red, smoke-gpu-batch32 failing. anyone nearby?
ci-bot: Pipeline main - job `smoke-gpu-batch32` failed (shard 7). https://ci.internal/runs/98765
jen: pinging, i'll grab logs :coffee:
alex: tagging ops, could be batchsize-triggered kernel path. @sanjeev any ideas?
sanjeev: on call in 10m. quick question — did we change any kernel selection heuristics in that PR?
sam: only changed the dynamic batching decision: prefer batch<=32 for latency. tiny diff.
jen: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-18T19:12:03Z ERROR runtime: kernel_assert at attention_cuda.cu:412
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
  what():  cudaMemcpy failed: out of memory
```
jen: looks like OOM in attention on shard 7, but the same shard passed on staging earlier.
alex: hmmm could be input distribution on main was slightly higher. can we rerun that job first?
sam: rerun requested: `ci retry 98765 --job smoke-gpu-batch32 --shard 7`
ci-bot: Rerun queued (run id 98766). Estimated 3m.
ryan: if rerun flakes, we should bisect between merge base and this commit before reverting. quick revert is ok if impacting prod.
jen: rerun 98766 started. Will report back.
jen: update — rerun passed on shard 7 but another shard (3) now failed with similar trace.
jen: new log:
```
E runtime: segmentation fault in fused_attention at fused.cu:87
GPU0: stacktrace ...
```
sanjeev: pattern suggests kernel regression that amplifies with certain batch shapes. I'll start a local repro with synthetic inputs from CI.
alex: can you try `BATCH_SZ=32 SEQ=1024 ./tools/run_smoke --shard=3` locally? that mimics the failing case.
sanjeev: running now. if repro is fast i'll bisect across last 5 merges.
sam: FYI this PR was a fast follow for perf; if it's flaky revert is safest for now.
ryan: agree, if we can confirm repro quickly and tie to PR then revert and hotfix later.
jen: also posting a short note on the PR asking author to stand by. @ci-bot can you annotate the PR with failing job link?
ci-bot: Added comment to PR #8423 with failing runs and logs.
jen: repro succeeded locally: segfault reproduces with SEQ=1024 batch=32. launching `git bisect` across main to find culprit.
sanjeev: ping me if bisect points to the kernel optimizer change — i'll own the revert.
alex: thanks — leaving a watch. :eyes:
jen: quick status: bisect narrowed to commit `c3d9f2a` (dependency bump in attention kernels). opening revert PR now.
sam: thanks team. once revert merged i'll trigger a full main smoke.
ci-bot: New run 98770 triggered by revert PR.
jen: will monitor, and post final here when green.
ryan: great triage, team.
jen: final — main smoke green after revert. closing the thread. :tada:
